kind: author numerical check, not an independent review
scope: Four-point, unwindowed illustrative DFT scores; not a new audio model experiment or a reconstruction guarantee. The complex transform uses a negative sine sign; squaring magnitude keeps the shown sum of squares.
installed_official_api_formula:
Ignoring the optional batch dimension, this method computes the following
expression:

.. math::
    X[\omega, m] = \sum_{k = 0}^{\text{win\_length-1}}%
                        \text{window}[k]\ \text{input}[m \times \text{hop\_length} + k]\ %
                        \exp\left(- j \frac{2 \pi \cdot \omega k}{\text{n\_fft}}\right),

where :math:`m` is the index of the sliding window, and :math:`\omega` is
the frequency :math:`0 \leq \omega < \text{n\_fft}` for ``onesided=False``,
or :math:`0 \leq \omega < \lfloor \text{n\_fft} / 2 \rfloor + 1` for ``onesided=True``.
